[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. **Pumpkin Spice Hot Chocolate**: Mix in pumpkin puree, cinnamon, and nutmeg.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. **Mint to Be Hot Chocolate**: Infuse with fresh mint leaves and honey.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. **Irish Cream Hot Chocolate**: Add Baileys Irish Cream liqueur and whipped cream.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 11. **Kahlúa Hot Chocolate**: Mix in Kahlúa liqueur and cream.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 12. **Vegan Hot Chocolate**: Use non-dairy milk, vegan chocolate chips, and maple syrup.
